note: Cross-repo contract for billing an approved marketplace milestone (web WP-93, app MS-03). This file is duplicated byte-for-byte in work-address/web (api/src/test/fixture) and work-address/app (api/src/test/fixture); they are separate repositories, so each owns a copy. web asserts MilestoneInvoiceClient PRODUCES these bytes, this header and this signature; app asserts its MarketplaceMilestoneInvoiceDto re-serialises to exactly them and that the controller ACCEPTS them. milestoneRef is the marketplace's milestone id and the app's idempotency key: the same reference pushed again answers with the first invoice, and pushed again for another contract, freelancer, amountCents or escrow allocation it is a 409, so everything but issuedAt and nonce must be the same on every retry. amountCents is whole cents (a milestone agreed for 400 USDT is 40000). workStart and workEnd are unix seconds and workEnd is after workStart. chainId, escrow, allocationId and invoiceCommitment bind the invoice to the escrow allocation that paid the milestone, so the settlement push for that allocation marks it PAID: they are the allocation's chain, escrow (lowercase), bytes32 id (lowercase) and the bytes32 its bill committed to (lowercase), sent only for a milestone whose release is confirmed, and all four are null for one approved without escrow. The allocation id must be the milestone's own - keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256 chainId, address escrow, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(string "work-address:milestone", string milestoneRef)))) - or the bill is a 409. issuedAt (unix seconds) and nonce are the replay guard. The HMAC-SHA256 hex signature over the exact serialised bytes goes in the header named below, with the shared entitlement secret. Every key is always present, in this order. Change both copies in the same pull request or not at all.
